overview.title: Overview
overview.content: Docling OCR is a powerful tool for converting documents to various formats using artificial intelligence. The application supports two processing pipelines that can be used simultaneously without configuration switching.

standard.title: Standard Pipeline (std)
standard.description: Uses specialized AI models for different tasks:
features: OCR with EasyOCR support (multi-language, GPU acceleration)
standard.bestFor: Best for: production use, offline/on-premise deployment, reliable performance

vlm.title: VLM Pipeline (vlm)
vlm.description: Uses Vision-Language models for end-to-end document processing:
features: Support for OpenAI-compatible APIs (vLLM, Ollama, OpenRouter)
Models: Qwen3-VL, Qwen2.5-VL, Pixtral, Granite-Vision and more
vlm.bestFor: Best for: complex documents, experimental use, custom models, specialized document types
vlm.note: ⚠️ Requires configuration: set DOCLING_VLM_ENABLED=true and configure VLM API settings

ocr.title: OCR (Optical Character Recognition)
ocr.description: Automatic detection and processing of scanned documents

modes.auto: auto — automatic detection of OCR necessity (recommended)

input.title: Input formats:
input.list: PDF, DOCX, DOC, XLSX, XLS, PPTX, PPT, TXT, CSV, JSON, HTML, XML, JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, EPUB

archives.title: Archives:
archives.list: ZIP, RAR, 7Z (automatic extraction and processing of all files)

tables.title: Table Extraction
tables.description: Structured table extraction with row and column preservation. Available via API endpoint /extract/tables

chunking.title: Document Chunking (for RAG)
chunking.description: Splitting documents into chunks for use in vector databases. Supports three modes: simple (character-based), semantic (hierarchical), and hybrid (hierarchical + tokenization).

docTags.title: Doc Tags (Structured Data)
docTags.description: Complete structured document information: texts, tables, images, metadata. Useful for advanced processing and analysis.

ui.title: Via Web Interface
steps: Select a file or drag it to the upload zone
Choose pipeline (Standard or VLM) in the top panel
Configure advanced options (output format, OCR mode, VLM prompt)
View results in various tabs (Raw Text, Markdown Preview, JSON Tables, Doc Tags)
Download result as MD file or ZIP archive

chunk.title: POST /ocr/docling/chunk
chunk.description: Split document into chunks for RAG
chunk.params: pipeline, chunking_mode (0/1/2), chunk_size (for mode=0), chunk_overlap (for mode=0), max_tokens (for mode=2)

health.title: GET /ocr/docling/health
health.description: Check service status and pipeline availability

scanned.title: Processing Scanned PDFs
scanned.description: Use Standard pipeline with OCR mode 'auto' or 'always'. The system will automatically detect OCR necessity.

digital.title: Processing Digital Documents
digital.description: Use Standard pipeline with OCR mode 'never' for fast processing of documents with text layer.

complex.title: Complex Documents with Tables
complex.description: Use Standard pipeline with 'Extract Tables' option or VLM pipeline with table extraction prompt.

batch.title: Batch Processing
batch.description: Upload a ZIP archive — all supported files will be automatically extracted and processed.

rag.title: RAG Preparation
rag.description: Use 'Enable Chunking' option or API endpoint /chunk to split documents into chunks for vector databases.

tips.title: Tips & Recommendations
list: For best OCR quality, use Standard pipeline with GPU acceleration (if available)
VLM pipeline requires API key configuration (e.g., OpenRouter)
For large documents, use 'json' or 'doctags' output format for structured data
Archives are automatically processed — just upload ZIP/RAR/7Z file
Doc Tags contain complete structured document information — useful for programmatic processing
Use custom VLM prompts for specialized tasks (e.g., extract only tables or formulas)
